name: watch
description: Watch a video where what is shown matters (slides, screens, code, a demo), learn what it teaches from both the words and the pictures, keep notes in a library that lasts, and turn it into a skill. Free, local, no API keys.

interface.shortDescription: Learn a video from its words and pictures
interface.longDescription: Give it a YouTube link, a video link or a video file. It gets the words (captions first, otherwise transcribed on your computer) and takes pictures where the scene changes, learns from both, keeps notes in your own words in ~/learning-library, and writes a new skill from them that you read and approve before it is saved. Free, no API keys.
defaultPrompt: Watch this: <link>. Learn what it teaches and turn it into a skill I can use forever, for <what you want it for>.
Watch this coding tutorial and turn it into a skill for building my own dashboards.
What does my library say about charts?
